flaw.definition:
n. defect or weakness in a person's character
n. an imperfection in a plan or theory or legal document that causes it to fail or that reduces its effectiveness
v. add a flaw or blemish to; make imperfect or defective
flaw.translation:
n. 缺点, 裂纹, 瑕疵, 一阵狂风
[化] 划痕; 裂缝; 裂纹

flawed.definition:
v add a flaw or blemish to; make imperfect or defective
s having a blemish or flaw
flawed.translation: a. 有缺陷的；有裂纹的；有瑕疵的

flawing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Flaw

flawless.translation:
a. 无瑕疵的, 无缺点的
[化] 无裂纹的; 无裂缝的

flawlessly.translation: adv. 无瑕地, 完美地

flawlessness.definition: n. the state of being without a flaw or defect

flawn.definition: n. A sort of flat custard or pie.

flaws.definition:
n an imperfection in an object or machine
n defect or weakness in a person's character
n an imperfection in a plan or theory or legal document that causes it to fail or that reduces its effectiveness
v add a flaw or blemish to; make imperfect or defective
flaws.translation: n. 缺点( flaw的名词复数 ); 错误; 裂痕

flawy.definition:
a. Full of flaws or cracks; broken; defective; faulty.
a. Subject to sudden flaws or gusts of wind.
